responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, risk_margin_count * 1.0 / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff_from_avg FROM s ORDER BY time_in_force

assumptions.assumption: Share is a fraction of the total matched risk/margin records (0 to 1), not a percentage, and is unrounded.

The average share is the simple mean of the per-time-in-force shares (equal to 1 divided by the number of time-in-force groups present), and only time-in-force values with at least one matched record appear.
'How far the share is from the average' is reported as the signed difference (share minus average share); negative means below average.
Each matched riskandmargin row counts as one record, and orders.recordvault is treated as unique so the join does not duplicate rows. Orders with a NULL timespan would form their own NULL group.

alternatives.interpretation: Report the distance as an absolute (unsigned) difference from the average share.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, risk_margin_count * 1.0 / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, share, ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS share_diff_from_avg FROM s ORDER BY time_in_force

assumptions.assumption: Time in force is orders.timespan; the count is the number of matched riskandmargin rows per value (inner join, unmatched dropped). Orders with NULL timespan form their own group.
The 'average share across time-in-force values' is the mean of the per-group shares, and the difference is signed (share minus average).

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan) SELECT time_in_force, cnt AS risk_margin_count, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () - AVG(cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER ()) OVER () AS share_diff_from_avg_share FROM c

assumptions.assumption: Count of risk/margin records is COUNT(*) of matched riskandmargin rows per orders.timespan; orders with NULL timespan form their own group and are included.
Share is each group's count divided by the total matched count; 'how far' is the signed difference (share minus the unweighted average of shares across time-in-force values), not absolute value.
recordvault is unique in orders, so the join does not duplicate risk/margin rows.

alternatives.interpretation: Distance from the average share as an absolute value (unsigned deviation).
